model_id: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 family; exact serving revision unverified)

correctness_confidence.basis: The model permits restoring any host outside the leader support without jeopardizing a tie. The residual group bound keeps the highest baseline degree and assumes no challenger loss. Both steps are conservative. The integer dual bound has the correct sign and the explicit omissions attain the reported thresholds.

rigor.basis: The minimum of 38 follows from 11 integer certificates covering 2,583 challengers plus a direct witness. The headline graph has two different omission units defined before calculation, with exact matching lower and upper bounds. The two-host enumeration correctly counts all 249,571 combinations.

novelty.basis: Source-supported edge survival is a specific empirical estimand in a newly released dataset. Integer box-dual certificates and network missing-data sensitivity are established. The short bibliography does not establish a new optimization method or priority across bibliometrics.

significance.basis: A change from 38 hosts to 32 or 35 groups matters for interpreting source resilience. Results address one ranking in a fixed corpus, without transaction amounts, ownership resolution or verified syndication.

reproducibility.basis: The host check reconstructs the pinned file and verifies integer bounds independently of the optimizer. The grouped calculations retain coefficients and witnesses but lack a second separately implemented verifier. I read all four rendered pages of this hash.

summary: Suitable for circulation as a working paper on the measurement of documented AI investment relationships. The exact thresholds have a clear denominator, the rivals are exhaustively covered, and the manuscript interprets correlated source units carefully. The main limitation is the gap between matching headlines and actual republication, especially for the 23-host transitive component. The inference is conditional on the upstream extraction and normalization. I reviewed the PDF in the same authoring context in which I helped make it.
strengths: The exact threshold combines a solver-free exclusion of smaller budgets with a concrete, fully recounted tie.
The comparison distinguishes actor normalization from shared documentary coverage.
The four-page PDF has readable formulae and an interpretable table with units, component sizes and resulting tie degrees.
weaknesses: The paper does not manually audit the 31 pairs of hosts with matching headlines.
Only one outcome and one pinned extraction are studied. The data do not identify undisclosed transactions.
The abstract omits the numerical results for grouped headlines.
potential_errors: Republishing and common press releases can produce identical dated headlines without common ownership. Transitive grouping may merge distinct reporting organizations.
The same row filter is reused by both hostname implementations, so reproduction cannot detect a shared error in upstream semantics.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact minimum omissions for this published investment corpus, with a 38-host witness, a solver-free certificate, and two prespecified sensitivity analyses.
